payload.title: stories repair-image-paths needs boto3, which a plain install does not have
payload.description: Found 2026-11-04 on 5.86.0: papyrus-newsroom without the markus extra crashes with No module named boto3 at the write step, after printing its plan. Signed-in --images and ops content renditions likely share this. The commands are meant for an ordinary install, so anything they import belongs in base dependencies, as in PPY-a4ae21. Also: references backfill-medium --write on the signed-in lane fails with Not Authorized to access updateReference; state that it is an operator command, or give it a signed-in path.
